description: This file defines the GDToolkit class for image manipulation within Drupal, including image loading, saving, format support, and configuration.

classes.name: GDToolkit
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for GD2 image manipulation, supporting image loading, saving, format support, and configuration.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets or resets the GD image object.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves the current GD image object, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for image quality settings.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Saves the configuration form settings.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an image from a file into the GD image object.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the current image data is valid.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current image to a specified destination.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses image file info and sets image type.

methods.name: getTransparentColor
methods.description: Gets the transparent color for GIF images.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the PHP IMAGETYPE_* constant of the image.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the PHP IMAGETYPE_* constant of the image.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: getRequirements
methods.description: Returns the requirements and support info for GD library and image formats.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if GD2 support is available.

methods.name: getSupportedExtensions
methods.description: Returns supported image file extensions.

methods.name: extensionToImageType
methods.description: Converts a file extension to an IMAGETYPE_* constant.

methods.name: checkAvifSupport
methods.description: Checks if AVIF encoding is supported.

methods.name: supportedTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported image types.
